scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['build', 'dist', 'web-ext-artifacts']) fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node build/scripts/build.js && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --filename firefox-cloudleak-{version}.xpi
scripts.test: node -e "fs.rmSync('build', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir build/extension && node --test build/tests/*.test.js
scripts.lint: biome ci --error-on-warnings && npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist --warnings-as-errors
scripts.check: npm test && npm run lint && npm audit
